title: Machine learning estimates gestational age from newborn metabolic and clinical data
summary: Elastic net regression models were derived from heel prick blood and clinical data of a retrospective Ontario newborn cohort and then applied to prospective birth cohorts in Zambia (N=311) and Bangladesh (N=1176). The best model estimated gestational age within about 6 days of early-pregnancy ultrasound for heel prick data (MAE 0.79 weeks in Zambia, 0.81 weeks in Bangladesh) and within about 7 days for cord blood data. Elastic net is penalized linear regression, a borderline machine learning method. Preprint of 2020-07-25.
ai_technology: Elastic net multivariable linear regression on heel prick metabolic and clinical data to estimate postnatal gestational age

evidence.tested: External validation in Zambia (N=311, MAE 0.79 weeks) and Bangladesh (N=1176, MAE 0.81 weeks) against early-pregnancy ultrasound estimates.
evidence.unknown: Use in routine surveillance and peer-reviewed status are not established from the abstract; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Penalized linear regression models estimated gestational age from metabolic and clinical features.
